consequence.statement: Remote clusters installed with the istiod-remote chart must change how they are installed: the istiod-remote chart has been merged into the istio-discovery chart, so they now install istio/istiod with profile=remote, and they also need the istio-base chart.
consequence.remediation: Install remote clusters with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` instead of the istiod-remote chart, and install the istio-base chart in both local and remote clusters.

original.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istiod-remote Helm chart is merged into the regular istio-discovery (istiod) chart. Clusters that use a remote control plane are now installed with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` instead of `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote`, and they also need the istio-base chart.

decision.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the `istiod-remote` chart was removed in favor of installing istio-discovery with `--set profile=remote`. [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and the upgrade guide [ev-1295567312b0] say the chart was merged into istio-discovery and give the new install command `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote`. Both also say the istio-base chart is now required in local and remote clusters. Because the chart no longer exists, operators who used it must switch to the replacement, so migration-required is supported, and medium severity fits a change that upstream calls never officially documented or stable.
